page.overview:
Who is Korrina?

Korrina is the Gym Leader at Shalour City's Gym and the successor of the Tower of Mastery. She specializes in -type Pokémon. Her Gym has of sets of rails that the player character must ride to reach her. She also gives the player character a Lucario, which has a Mega Stone to allow the player character to Mega Evolve it. She can be fought at the Battle Chateau if a Writ of Invitation is sent out.

When she isn't battling, she wears red sunglasses in place of her helmet and a gray V-neck over her top as well as white high tops with red wheels fitted in the bottom.

Five years later, her hair is now held in a bun, with a long and fluffy strand of hair emerging like a ring. She also wears on her head a long bandana thats is colored in various hues of yellow, green, blue, and purple, it also has the Mega Evolution sigil printed on it. Her new attire consists of a zipper crop top with a tall collar and double-layered shorts, all also colored in various hues of yellow, green, blue, and purple. She also wears white arm-length gloves and white boots with yellow-green laces and soles. Her left glove still contains her Key Stone. Korrina also now carries many different Mega Stones contained in bandolier-like straps that wrap around her torso and waist.

Korrina is an enthusiastic girl, who sometimes acts childishly in front of her grandfather. Despite this, she actually cares for Gurkinn, as well as the Tower of Mastery and Mega Evolution successor tradition.
